posts.headline: One Nut Barner just hit twenty-five straight editions of total radio silence, and this league is done waiting for Put it in Ra to say a word about a 20-8 career mark and a 1.5 average finish with zero rings to show for it.
posts.detail: Best regular-season résumé in the building — 20-8, two straight finishes inside the top two — and yet the loudest thing about him is his complete absence from the conversation. Rings mean nothing if you never even show up to talk about winning one.

posts.headline: Sasinci's World has now stonewalled this column for six straight editions, and Big Head has exactly one draft left before the fluke jury renders a permanent verdict on that title.
posts.detail: A championship banner sitting on top of a 13-15 career record is the most Megamind paradox in league history — a big head with nothing to back it up. Draft well or the quitting threats might finally have a real reason behind them.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh drafts tonight still carrying the worst résumé in the league, and the untalented tenth nickname has never had less competition for the title.
posts.detail: A 4-10 record and a dead-last 12th-place finish is the floor of this entire twelve-team field, and there's no sign a new roster fixes what the GM'ing broke.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT walks into draft night with the same cursed instincts that once produced a first-overall DEFENSIVE player, and the Ultimate Light Skin owes this league a real sermon this time.
posts.detail: A 13-14-1 career mark says the plagues haven't lifted, and picking scripture over stats again would be the most on-brand disaster this league has seen in two seasons.

posts.headline: Thicks and the #FreeMaxx Champions enter the final countdown to draft night still needing to prove the ring wasn't a fluke wrapped in a 5.5 average finish.
posts.detail: A 14-14 career record backing up a championship banner is thin ice, and every pick tonight either builds a real dynasty or exposes a one-year mirage.
